import math

outer_diameter = 52.3
inner_diameter = 31.5
thickness = 7.0
hole_diameter = 3.5
hole_depth = 1.7
hole_count = 9

inner_radius = inner_diameter / 2.0

solid_body = solid_body - Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(inner_radius, thickness)

    solid_body = solid_body - Pos(x, 1.65, z) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(hole_radius, hole_depth)

part = solid_body
part.name = "flanged_disc_with_holes"

inner_diameter = 31.5
flange_thickness = 7.0
hole_diameter = 3.5
